ar: قُلْ أُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْءَانًا عَجَبًا
tr: Qul oohiya ilayya annahu istamaAAa nafarun mina aljinni faqaloo inna samiAAna quranan AAajaban
en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur’ān [i.e., recitation].

ar: يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشْدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدًا
tr: Yahdee ila alrrushdi faamanna bihi walan nushrika birabbina ahadan
en: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone.

ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ تَعَـٰلَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَـٰحِبَةً وَلَا وَلَدًا
tr: Waannahu taAAala jaddu rabbina ma ittakhatha sahibatan wala waladan
en: And [it teaches] that exalted is the nobleness of our Lord; He has not taken a wife or a son

ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ شَطَطًا
tr: Waannahu kana yaqoolu safeehuna AAala Allahi shatatan
en: And that our foolish one [i.e., Iblees] has been saying about Allāh an excessive transgression.

ar: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن تَقُولَ ٱلْإِنسُ وَٱلْجِنُّ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا
tr: Waanna thananna an lan taqoola alinsu waaljinnu AAala Allahi kathiban
en: And we had thought that mankind and the jinn would never speak about Allāh a lie.

ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ رِجَالٌ مِّنَ ٱلْإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقًا
tr: Waannahu kana rijalun mina alinsi yaAAoothoona birijalin mina aljinni fazadoohum rahaqan
en: And there were men from mankind who sought refuge in men from the jinn, so they [only] increased them in burden [i.e., sin].

ar: وَأَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّوا۟ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدًا
tr: Waannahum thannoo kama thanantum an lan yabAAatha Allahu ahadan
en: And they had thought, as you thought, that Allāh would never send anyone [as a messenger].

ar: وَأَنَّا لَمَسْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدْنَـٰهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَسًا شَدِيدًا وَشُهُبًا
tr: Waanna lamasna alssamaa fawajadnaha muliat harasan shadeedan washuhuban
en: And we have sought [to reach] the heaven but found it filled with powerful guards and burning flames.

ar: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَـٰعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ ۖ فَمَن يَسْتَمِعِ ٱلْـَٔانَ يَجِدْ لَهُۥ شِهَابًا رَّصَدًا
tr: Waanna kunna naqAAudu minha maqaAAida lilssamAAi faman yastamiAAi alana yajid lahu shihaban rasadan
en: And we used to sit therein in positions for hearing, but whoever listens now will find a burning flame lying in wait for him.

ar: وَأَنَّا لَا نَدْرِىٓ أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ أَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَدًا
tr: Waanna la nadree asharrun oreeda biman fee alardi am arada bihim rabbuhum rashadan
en: And we do not know [therefore] whether evil is intended for those on earth or whether their Lord intends for them a right course.

ar: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّـٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدًا
tr: Waanna minna alssalihoona waminna doona thalika kunna taraiqa qidadan
en: And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways.

ar: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعْجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَن نُّعْجِزَهُۥ هَرَبًا
tr: Wanna thananna an lan nuAAjiza Allaha fee alardi walan nuAAjizahu haraban
en: And we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allāh upon earth, nor can we escape Him by flight.

ar: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ فَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِرَبِّهِۦ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخْسًا وَلَا رَهَقًا
tr: Waanna lamma samiAAna alhuda amanna bihi faman yumin birabbihi fala yakhafu bakhsan wala rahaqan
en: And when we heard the guidance [i.e., the Qur’ān], we believed in it. And whoever believes in his Lord will not fear deprivation or burden.

ar: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا ٱلْقَـٰسِطُونَ ۖ فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوْا۟ رَشَدًا
tr: Waanna minna almuslimoona waminna alqasitoona faman aslama faolaika taharraw rashadan
en: And among us are Muslims [in submission to Allāh], and among us are the unjust. And whoever has become Muslim - those have sought out the right course.

ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلْقَـٰسِطُونَ فَكَانُوا۟ لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًا
tr: Waama alqasitoona fakanoo lijahannama hataban
en: But as for the unjust, they will be, for Hell, firewood.'

ar: وَأَلَّوِ ٱسْتَقَـٰمُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسْقَيْنَـٰهُم مَّآءً غَدَقًا
tr: Waallawi istaqamoo AAala alttareeqati laasqaynahum maan ghadaqan
en: And [Allāh revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant rain [i.e., provision].

ar: لِّنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ ۚ وَمَن يُعْرِضْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِۦ يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًا صَعَدًا
tr: Linaftinahum feehi waman yuAArid AAan thikri rabbihi yaslukhu AAathaban saAAadan
en: So We might test them therein. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord He will put into arduous punishment.

ar: وَأَنَّ ٱلْمَسَـٰجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدْعُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدًا
tr: Waanna almasajida lillahi fala tadAAoo maAAa Allahi ahadan
en: And [He revealed] that the masjids are for Allāh, so do not invoke with Allāh anyone.

ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ يَدْعُوهُ كَادُوا۟ يَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَدًا
tr: Waannahu lamma qama AAabdu Allahi yadAAoohu kadoo yakoonoona AAalayhi libadan
en: And that when the Servant [i.e., Prophet] of Allāh stood up supplicating Him, they almost became about him a compacted mass."

ar: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى وَلَآ أُشْرِكُ بِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا
tr: Qul innama adAAoo rabbee wala oshriku bihi ahadan
en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "I only invoke my Lord and do not associate with Him anyone."

ar: قُلْ إِنِّى لَآ أَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا رَشَدًا
tr: Qul innee la amliku lakum darran wala rashadan
en: Say, "Indeed, I do not possess for you [the power of] harm or right direction."

ar: قُلْ إِنِّى لَن يُجِيرَنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٌ وَلَنْ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلْتَحَدًا
tr: Qul innee lan yujeeranee mina Allahi ahadun walan ajida min doonihi multahadan
en: Say, "Indeed, there will never protect me from Allāh anyone [if I should disobey], nor will I find in other than Him a refuge.

ar: إِلَّا بَلَـٰغًا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِسَـٰلَـٰتِهِۦ ۚ وَمَن يَعْصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا
tr: Illa balaghan mina Allahi warisalatihi waman yaAAsi Allaha warasoolahu fainna lahu nara jahannama khalideena feeha abadan
en: But [I have for you] only notification from Allāh, and His messages." And whoever disobeys Allāh and His Messenger - then indeed, for him is the fire of Hell; they will abide therein forever.

ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَضْعَفُ نَاصِرًا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدًا
tr: Hatta itha raaw ma yooAAadoona fasayaAAlamoona man adAAafu nasiran waaqallu AAadadan
en: [The disbelievers continue] until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number.

ar: قُلْ إِنْ أَدْرِىٓ أَقَرِيبٌ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهُۥ رَبِّىٓ أَمَدًا
tr: Qul in adree aqareebun ma tooAAadoona am yajAAalu lahu rabbee amadan
en: Say, "I do not know if what you are promised is near or if my Lord will grant for it a [long] period."

ar: عَـٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَلَا يُظْهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيْبِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا
tr: AAalimu alghaybi fala yuthhiru AAala ghaybihi ahadan
en: [He is] Knower of the unseen, and He does not disclose His [knowledge of the] unseen to anyone

ar: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولٍ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَسْلُكُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِۦ رَصَدًا
tr: Illa mani irtada min rasoolin fainnahu yasluku min bayni yadayhi wamin khalfihi rasadan
en: Except whom He has approved of messengers, and indeed, He sends before him [i.e., each messenger] and behind him observers

ar: لِّيَعْلَمَ أَن قَدْ أَبْلَغُوا۟ رِسَـٰلَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَأَحْصَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عَدَدًۢا
tr: LiyaAAlama an qad ablaghoo risalati rabbihim waahata bima ladayhim waahsa kulla shayin AAadadan
en: That he [i.e., Muḥammad (ﷺ)] may know that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord; and He has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number.
